messages:
tara: Follow-up from the onboarding RFC: we've got a batch of quantized builds that clear unit checks but exhibit big tail latency when the cached prefix toggles. Repro available. Anyone familiar with prefetch threshold regressions?

alex: Is this during the lightweight smoke or the longer microbench?

tara: Hits during the quick-smoke (1k sample). Median fine, but p95/p99 spikes 2-4x on sequences that flip the cached-prefix boundary. Full microbench averages out, but we can't ignore the tail.

maria: Could be kernel selection oscillation. Some runtimes switch to a slower attention kernel once sequence length > N. Quantized kernels sometimes lack the optimized path.

ranjit: Agreed. We should capture which kernels are chosen. Current sandbox hides kernel names for safety, but we can add a dev-only trace toggle.

ben: We have a "trace_level" flag in the preflight harness but it only emits timings. I can extend it to include kernel IDs (scrubbed) and strip them in artifacts before storing.

jess: From a product POV we need a quicker unblock: propose two acceptance lanes — "quick-pass" and "deep-verify". Quick-pass = functional + perf guard rails suitable for low-QPS canaries. Deep-verify = full bench + kernel trace + numerical stability checks.

tara: I like lanes. Quick-pass must be conservative on routing: limit to compat-matched runtimes and QPS caps.

alex: To make routing deterministic we need manifest hints exposing execution capabilities. Not free-form strings: enum fields like prefetch_capacity: [NONE, SMALL, LARGE], kv_cache: [SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED], fused_attn: [V1, V2, UNKNOWN].

maria: Yes. Also add a "prefetch_boundary" numeric field with a hard upper bound validated during ingest. If a model advertises prefetch_boundary=2048 but fails at 1024 we should mark it inconsistent.

ranjit: Implementation note: ingest currently emits metadata blob. We'll add a compact flat map called "exec_hints". Example: exec_hints = "kv_cache=SUPPORTED;prefetch_boundary=1024;fused_attn=V2". Keep it flat for easy parsing.

ben: We'll also version the schema like exec_hints_v=1. Routers should treat unknown keys as conservative (assume NOT_SUPPORTED).

bench-bot: bench-runner: quick-smoke for model qv1-q4 completed. Functional: pass. perf-sample median=18ms, p95=320ms (guard p95=120ms).

alex: p95 >> guard. Block auto-promotion. Auto-schedule deep-verify?

ben: Yes. Rule: quick-pass only auto-promotes if p95 <= guard AND exec_hints present. Else enqueue deep-verify job (kernel trace + extended bench).

maria: Deep-verify is expensive. Prioritize deep-verify queue by projected traffic and embedded size. Use registry traffic forecast + customer interest tag.

tara: Also add a temporary mitigation: if kernel trace shows a deterministic big-kernel fallback on certain seq lengths, route offending sequences to a float variant if available until the issue is fixed.

jess: For rollout policy we need an automated safety net: quick-pass canaries get a circuit breaker that trips on sustained p95 regression for 10 minutes and rolls back.

ranjit: I'll prototype a kernel-trace opt-in that writes a sanitized list of kernel IDs and invocation sizes. It will be gated behind an internal flag and scrubbed of host paths.

ben: I'll add parsing and validation in ingest to reject bogus prefetch_boundary values and enforce enumerated fields. Also add unit tests covering boundary violations.

alex: I'll update router logic to prefer routes that match exec_hints, falling back to compatibility scoring, then latency tier. Keep changes minimal: a small pre-filter before our existing ranking.

maria: I'll expand the golden sample set to include cache-bound dialog patterns and single-token reply floods. Add these samples to preflight and deep-verify suites.

tara: Action items: ben+ranjit prototyping trace + ingest checks, alex router fallback PR, maria golden-set update, jess define rollout circuit-breaker thresholds. I'll draft a short RFC addendum with the exec_hints schema and the lane state machine.

bench-bot: bench-runner: deep-verify job queued for qv1-q4.

tara: Thanks team. We'll review the RFC addendum in Tuesday's infra sync. :thumbsup:
